name: @bankoneth/web
description: Self-contained, framework-free bankon.eth dApp (subdomain minter + generic ABI explorer) and a separate ERC-7857 iNFT page. Prototype build — no bundler required to run.

comments.run: From packages/web/: `npm run abis` (after `forge build`) then `npm run serve` and open http://localhost:8788/bankoneth.html (or /inft.html).
comments.deploy: Static files — copy bankoneth.html, inft.html, inft.css, bankon-forms.js, iNFTabi.js, vendor/ and public/ to bankon.pythai.net / agenticplace.pythai.net.
